name: Angela's Valentine
summary: The app game mainly consists of postcards that show the characters doing stuff with words at the bottom (such as Angela throwing a pie at Tom with words that say "love is so sweet", or Angela with an umbrella and Tom's in the rain while there are words "I love you even, when I'm angry!"). The game also has the songs You Get Me and That’s Falling In Love replacing the movies on the cinema. Tom can also either kiss Angela (which can sometimes show on the cinema screen) or reach his hand out at her and Angela will hit it.
